Rhun ap Iorwerth ( Welsh pronunciation: [r̥ɨːn ap ˈjɔrwɛrθ] ; [ 2 ] born 27 August 1972) is a Welsh politician and journalist who has served as the Leader of Plaid Cymru since June 2023. He was the Member of the Senedd (MS) for Ynys Môn since 2013 , and then has been MS for Bangor Conwy Môn since May 2026.
